verdicts.proof: Old: validation_banner.dart:45-53 checkOverlap; red box placed right above REZERVOVAT (moto_detail_page.dart if(hasDates) ValidationBanner, then _buildCtaButton). v2 detail: same widget at detail_trip_card_v2.dart:191, rendered as amber MgStateBanner (validation_banner.dart:76-84), in the middle of the sheet, while the sticky dock CTA 'REZERVOVAT · price' stays active and animated (detail_dock_v2.dart:89-95; onReserve moto_detail_page.dart:275 ignores the banner). Home funnel entry home_funnel_v2.dart:216 calls startBookingFromSelection with no banner at all (funnel_provider.dart:108-133 filters licence only, no overlap). Hard stop still in booking form: booking_form_widget.dart:415 err=bookingValidationErrorProvider -> overlapValidationProvider (booking_provider.dart:237-256) in canProceedNow; server trg_check_user_booking_overlap (STATE_4:189).
verdicts.fix_idea: In v2 detail, when ValidationBanner has errors, show the first error in the dock context line in warn colour (as for busy) and make the dock CTA non-looping; or make the dock CTA scroll to the trip card banner first. In the Home funnel, drop candidates whose range overlaps the customer's own reservation (BookingValidator.checkOverlap) or show the same banner on the card.

verdicts.proof: Old: validation_banner.dart:57-65 min/max days, red box above REZERVOVAT. v2 detail: same banner amber mid-sheet (detail_trip_card_v2.dart:191) while sticky dock REZERVOVAT stays active (detail_dock_v2.dart:89-95). verdicts.fix_idea: Same dock warning as G-153; in funnelCandidatesProvider skip bikes whose min/max rental days do not fit the funnel range.

Old 4.1.3 (70a94933 moto_detail_page.dart ~:661-679) and current old path booking_entry.dart:65-69 always set a fresh BookingDraft (consents false, discounts empty). v2 booking_entry.dart:71-90 -> booking_carry_v2.dart:35-44: same bike keeps prev draft (consentVop/consentGdpr/consentKids, discounts, extras, delivery) with only dates replaced, even when the dates changed; other bike :50-77 carries discount codes (List.of(prev.discounts)) but resets consents. No re-validation of carried codes on entry (validate_promo_code/validate_voucher_code only called in booking_provider.dart:90,120 when a code is typed). Fresh draft only if a payment was confirmed meanwhile or another account (booking_entry.dart:73-77, booking_carry_v2.dart:90-115). Applies to all v2 entries: detail dock, calculator calc_body_v2.dart:148, Home funnel home_funnel_v2.dart:216. Owner decision noted in code (booking_carry_v2.dart:9-26) but the default differs from the old look.
verdicts.fix_idea: In carryBookingDraft keep the filled fields but reset consentVop/consentGdpr/consentKids to false when the dates changed (or always), and re-run validate_promo_code/validate_voucher_code for carried discounts on form entry, dropping any code the server rejects with the existing promo error message.

verdicts.proof: Fresh draft never sets bootsSize from profile (booking_entry.dart:44-60, same as 70a94933). v2 carry only copies bootsSize from the previous draft (booking_carry_v2.dart:37 whole prev for same bike; :73 only sameSizing for another bike) - i.e. a value the customer chose in the form; the profile is never used.
